summary.fr: Les Goblins des Misty Mountains : amass fait grandir une Army Goblin, Goblin Plate Mail l'équipe, le removal noir et rouge déblaie. Bolg of the North et Fearsome Goblin Pair en étaient les signposts.
summary.en: The Misty Mountains Goblins: amass grows a Goblin Army, Goblin Plate Mail equips it, and black and red removal clears the way. Bolg of the North and Fearsome Goblin Pair were the signposts.

fr: La paire la plus jouée du set et son meilleur taux de victoire.
Pinecone Strike, Stir Up Trouble et Bilbo's Deadly Slice : du removal commun en quantité.
Crude Bent Blade et Gollum, Silent Slinker figuraient parmi ses communes les plus gagnantes.
en: The most-played pair of the set and its best win rate.
Pinecone Strike, Stir Up Trouble and Bilbo's Deadly Slice gave plenty of common removal.
Crude Bent Blade and Gollum, Silent Slinker were among its best-performing commons.

summary.fr: Wargs, ours et araignées de Mirkwood : ferocious récompense le contrôle d'une créature de force quatre ou plus, The Chief Warg pioche à chaque attaque. Large Bear était l'autre signpost.
summary.en: Mirkwood's Wargs, bears and spiders: ferocious rewards controlling a creature with power four or more, and The Chief Warg draws on each attack. Large Bear was the other signpost.

fr: Deuxième meilleur taux de victoire du set.
Quarrel et Bilbo's Deadly Slice : du removal commun dans les deux couleurs.
Attercop et Ravening Warg, deathtouch à deux mana, tenaient les premiers tours.
en: The second-best win rate of the set.
Quarrel and Bilbo's Deadly Slice gave common removal in both colors.
Attercop and Ravening Warg, two-mana deathtouch, held the early turns.

summary.fr: Sans signpost : les Nains blancs et leurs Equipments (Iron Hills Blacksmith, Dwarven Provisioner) avec le removal et Crude Bent Blade du noir.
summary.en: No signpost: the white Dwarves and their Equipment (Iron Hills Blacksmith, Dwarven Provisioner) with black's removal and Crude Bent Blade.

fr: Une paire marginale, mais au-dessus de la moyenne du set.
Crude Bent Blade et Gollum, Silent Slinker : deux communes noires très jouées.
Patient Instructor et Down, Down to Goblin-town figuraient parmi ses cartes les plus gagnantes.
en: A fringe pair, but above the set average.
Crude Bent Blade and Gollum, Silent Slinker were two heavily played black commons.
Patient Instructor and Down, Down to Goblin-town were among its best-performing cards.

summary.fr: Les Humains de Lake-town : recruit pioche-défausse et crée un Human Soldier, Bard the Bowman récompense la deuxième carte du tour. Bard the Bowman et Eagle's Rescue en étaient les signposts.
summary.en: The Humans of Lake-town: recruit loots and makes a Human Soldier, and Bard the Bowman rewards the second card drawn each turn. Bard the Bowman and Eagle's Rescue were the signposts.

fr: Deuxième paire la plus jouée, au-dessus de la moyenne du set.
Patient Instructor, Long Lake Nuisance et Plunder the Trollshaws : la pioche en commune.
Celebrate the Mountain-king et Bilbo, Luckwearer figuraient parmi ses cartes les plus gagnantes.
en: The second most-played pair, above the set average.
Patient Instructor, Long Lake Nuisance and Plunder the Trollshaws gave card flow at common.
Celebrate the Mountain-king and Bilbo, Luckwearer were among its best-performing cards.

main: Old Fat Spider Can't See Me

summary.fr: La compagnie de Thorin : storied (trois artefacts, légendaires ou Sagas) active les Nains, les Equipments complètent le compte. Thorin Oakenshield et Bifur, Melodic Rider en étaient les signposts.
summary.en: Thorin's company: storied (three artifacts, legendaries or Sagas) switches on the Dwarves, and Equipment fills out the count. Thorin Oakenshield and Bifur, Melodic Rider were the signposts.

fr: Au-dessus de la moyenne du set, à égalité avec Azorius.
Dori, Óin et Ori : des Nains légendaires en commune qui comptaient pour storied.
Celebrate the Mountain-king et Stone by Sunlight figuraient parmi ses cartes les plus gagnantes.
en: Above the set average, level with Azorius.
Dori, Óin and Ori were legendary common Dwarves that counted toward storied.
Celebrate the Mountain-king and Stone by Sunlight were among its best-performing cards.

main: Dáin, Lord of the Iron Hills

summary.fr: Sans signpost : la pioche bleue de Lake-town et le removal rouge (Pinecone Strike, Smaug, the Great Calamity), avec Bothersome Noisemaker pour l'amass.
summary.en: No signpost: Lake-town's blue card draw and red removal (Pinecone Strike, Smaug, the Great Calamity), with Bothersome Noisemaker for amass.

fr: Une paire marginale, légèrement sous la moyenne du set.
Pinecone Strike et Bothersome Noisemaker figuraient parmi ses cartes les plus gagnantes.
Aucune carte multicolore pour lier les deux couleurs.
en: A fringe pair, slightly below the set average.
Pinecone Strike and Bothersome Noisemaker were among its best-performing cards.
No gold card tied the two colors together.

summary.fr: Sans signpost : les créatures vertes de Mirkwood (Attercop, Mirkwood Pathmaker) et le removal rouge, avec Glóin the Mighty et les Sagas rouges.
summary.en: No signpost: Mirkwood's green creatures (Attercop, Mirkwood Pathmaker) and red removal, with Glóin the Mighty and the red Sagas.

fr: Très peu jouée, sous la moyenne du set.
Quarrel et Pinecone Strike : le removal commun des deux couleurs.
Mirkwood Pathmaker et Misty Mountains Raider figuraient parmi ses cartes les plus gagnantes.
en: Rarely played, below the set average.
Quarrel and Pinecone Strike were the common removal of both colors.
Mirkwood Pathmaker and Misty Mountains Raider were among its best-performing cards.

summary.fr: Sans signpost : la pioche bleue de Lake-town (Bilbo Baggins, Burglar, Plunder the Trollshaws) et le removal noir des Goblins (Bilbo's Deadly Slice, Stir Up Trouble).
summary.en: No signpost: Lake-town's blue card draw (Bilbo Baggins, Burglar, Plunder the Trollshaws) and the Goblins' black removal (Bilbo's Deadly Slice, Stir Up Trouble).

fr: Sous la moyenne du set : les deux couleurs étaient plus fortes dans leurs paires tribales.
Gollum, Silent Slinker et Stir Up Trouble figuraient parmi ses cartes les plus gagnantes.
Aucune carte multicolore pour lier les deux couleurs.
en: Below the set average: both colors were stronger in their tribal pairs.
Gollum, Silent Slinker and Stir Up Trouble were among its best-performing cards.
No gold card tied the two colors together.

summary.fr: Les Elfes de Mirkwood : landfall et terrains supplémentaires, Thranduil, Sindarin Liege crée un Elf à chaque terrain, Silvan Reveler revient du cimetière. Les deux en étaient les signposts.
summary.en: The Elves of Mirkwood: landfall and extra lands, Thranduil, Sindarin Liege makes an Elf with each land, and Silvan Reveler returns from the graveyard. Both were the signposts.

fr: Le plus faible taux de victoire des cinq paires principales.
Mirkwood Nurturer, très joué, était l'une de ses cartes les moins gagnantes.
Thranduil, Sindarin Liege et Mirkwood Pathmaker figuraient parmi ses cartes les plus gagnantes.
en: The lowest win rate of the five main pairs.
Mirkwood Nurturer, heavily played, was one of its weakest performers.
Thranduil, Sindarin Liege and Mirkwood Pathmaker were among its best-performing cards.

summary.fr: Sans signpost : une base verte de Mirkwood (Wood Elves, Mirkwood Pathmaker, Ordinary Bear) avec le removal blanc, Magnificent End en tête.
summary.en: No signpost: a green Mirkwood base (Wood Elves, Mirkwood Pathmaker, Ordinary Bear) with white removal, led by Magnificent End.

fr: La paire la moins jouée et le plus faible taux de victoire du set.
Aucune carte multicolore ni synergie tribale commune entre les deux couleurs.
Troll Negotiations figurait parmi ses cartes les plus gagnantes.
en: The least-played pair and the lowest win rate of the set.
No gold card and no shared tribal synergy between the two colors.
Troll Negotiations was among its best-performing cards.
